stdout:
What a request may ask
  ok    an amount, a channel and an offered number of days
  ok    anything else is nothing
  ok    nothing asked is not narrowed

The store's buyers, from its sales
  ok    each address once, all it paid, where it first came from
  ok    how many times each bought: each checkout once, an offer taken after paying not again (270 [GR1])
  ok    support and another store's sales are not buyers here
  ok    a buyer who paid in another currency is a buyer: the order and the date count, the money does not
  ok    the channels, the most buyers first
  ok    read again within ten minutes: nothing asked of Stripe

Who each narrowing keeps
  ok    spent at least $80: euros are not added, so not eve
  ok    first found you through Instagram
  ok    first found you directly, eve among them
  ok    has not bought in 90 days, but has bought: not eve, who bought three days ago
  ok    all three at once
  ok    one group of buyers: loyal, bought once, new
  ok    a group nobody is in keeps nobody, and never someone who is not a buyer
  ok    a draft keeps its group; one that is not a group is refused, never read as everyone
  ok    a narrowing with a field this version does not know is refused, never read as a broader group; a null group is none
  ok    a group is read from a request only when it is one of the groups

A list narrowed that way
  ok    only those who may be written to and match

Saved groups
  ok    a group needs a name
  ok    and needs to choose somebody
  ok    a product the store does not have is refused
  ok    saved
  ok    the same name replaces it
  ok    and it can be removed

Renewals, refunds and disputes (270 [GR1], unit 2)
  ok    a member's renewal moves their last purchase and adds what it paid, and is one more time they bought
  ok    a renewal with no checkout read is still a buyer, its payment one time they bought
  ok    another store's renewal is not
  ok    refunded in full is not a purchase; in part, what was kept counts
  ok    a dispute the buyer won, or one still open, is not a purchase either
  ok    a renewal in another currency moves the last payment, adding nothing
  ok    a buyer known only by a renewal came from the subscription's channel
  ok    a membership payment refunded in full, matched through the invoice's payments, does not count
  ok    all of it read: not partial

A membership's payment found through the account's invoice payments (270 [GR1], unit 3a)
  ok    a membership's first payment through checkout, refunded, is not a purchase
  ok    nor is a renewal refunded, matched by its invoice
  ok    still read in full
  ok    an invoice paid in parts: each part's refund is taken off
  ok    a member of a year counts every payment, and is a best customer
  ok    an unread list of invoice payments, when one was needed, makes the reading partial
